description: This file defines interfaces for the xdiff diffing library, including function pointer types, constants, and function prototypes related to diff computation and file comparison.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Outputs the diff between two files using user-defined callbacks.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads an object blob into a mmfile_t structure using its object ID.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets the function to find specific lines when processing diffs.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a conflict style name string into an internal representation.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures git’s merge style or behavior based on variables.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two strings for equality based on whitespace treatment flags.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Generates a hash of a string with whitespace handling flags.
